verdict.rationale: Choosing deployment regions is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. No evidence in the pack documents selecting or deploying to specific regions. The global CDN for static-asset caching (render-docs-19) is an adjacent feature, not regional placement of application compute, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy my application to specific regions closer to my users
